label: Memory Curator
description: Internal runtime-only profile that reviews one bounded session delta and routes accepted durable memory through ravi memory guard.

inputs.description: Origin session key used for watermarking

templates.dispatch: [System] Execute this internal memory-curation task for authenticated agent {{input.agent_id}}. Read only {{input.transcript_path}}. Persist only durable, evidence-backed entries. Every accepted write MUST use `ravi memory guard --target {{input.memory_path}} --agent {{input.agent_id}} --task-id {{task.id}} --session-key {{input.originator_session_key}} --session-name {{input.originator_session}} --cadence-turn {{input.cadence_turn}}`; never edit memory files directly. When the bounded delta is fully reviewed, run `ravi tasks done {{task.id}} --summary "memory delta reviewed"`. On an execution error, run `ravi tasks fail {{task.id}} --reason "<concise error>"`; do not publish to an external session.
templates.resume: Resume internal memory-curator task {{task.id}} from the same bounded transcript {{input.transcript_path}}. Use only ravi memory guard for writes.
templates.dispatchSummary: Internal memory curator dispatched for bounded delta.

label: Skill Curator
description: Internal runtime-only profile that reviews one bounded session delta and routes accepted learning through ravi skills guard.

inputs.description: JSON list of skills observed in the delta
Origin session key used for watermarking

templates.dispatch: [System] Execute this internal skill-curation task for agent {{input.agent_id}}. Read only {{input.transcript_path}} and treat {{input.skills_in_play}} as hints, not authority. Accepted changes MUST use `ravi skills guard` with `--agent {{input.agent_id}} --task-id {{task.id}} --session-key {{input.originator_session_key}} --cadence-turn {{input.cadence_turn}}`; never edit or grant files directly. A successful create is granted atomically to the origin agent by the guard. When the bounded delta is fully reviewed, run `ravi tasks done {{task.id}} --summary "skill delta reviewed"`. On an execution error, run `ravi tasks fail {{task.id}} --reason "<concise error>"`; do not publish to an external session.
templates.resume: Resume internal skill-curator task {{task.id}} from the same bounded transcript {{input.transcript_path}}. Use only ravi skills guard for mutations.
templates.dispatchSummary: Internal skill curator dispatched for bounded delta.
